registry.name: VC partner on the board at the first raise
registry.intuition: A director who also appears on Pooled Investment Fund filings is a VC. Smart money is visible in public filings.

registry.name: Board track record (point-in-time)
registry.intuition: Directors whose earlier companies scaled (>= $20M later raise) before this company's first raise pick or build winners.

registry.name: Professional board member
registry.intuition: A director already on 3+ other startups' filings.

registry.name: Serial founder/executive
registry.intuition: Officer appeared on an earlier startup's filing.

registry.name: Brokered round
registry.intuition: Paying a broker/finder means VCs passed.

registry.name: Public solicitation (506c)
registry.intuition: Advertising a raise to the public = no institutional lead.

registry.name: First raise big for its industry-year
Hot market at first raise
registry.intuition: Counter-cyclical: companies born in hot quarters are worse (more noise, worse prices).

registry.name: SAFE / convertible first raise
registry.intuition: Modern seed instrument vs priced round.

registry.name: Pre-revenue at first raise
registry.intuition: Venture-style bets vs small businesses with revenue.

registry.name: Number of investors in first raise
registry.intuition: Broad support, or a crowd of small angels.

registry.name: Company age at first raise
registry.intuition: Bootstrapped first vs raised at birth.

registry.name: Offering open more than a year
